---
title: 'Exploratory Analysis NHB1: Demographic Controls'
author: "Angelika Stefan"
date: "2026-10-15"
output: html_document
---

As suggested in the review phase of Stage 2 of this registered report, we conduct each confirmatory analysis with demographic control variables to check the robustness of effects. We use age (continuous covariate), gender (male/female; non-binary are counted as missing to avoid unequal group sizes), ethnicity (White/non-White) and education (Basic Education / Undergraduate / Postgraduate)

## Load packages

```{r setup}
library(brms)
library(bayestestR)
library(rstan)
library(dplyr)
```

## Read in and combine data from Prolific and MTurk

```{r}

# Read in data from both studies
nhb1a <- read.csv('../../data/nhb1a_processed.csv')
nhb1b <- read.csv('../../data/nhb1b_processed.csv')

nhb1a$platform <- "Prolific"
nhb1b$platform <- "MTurk"

# Combine data
nhb1 <- rbind(nhb1a, nhb1b)

# Compute standardized scores for composite political orientation in the combined dataset
nhb1$z_mean_SECS <- scale(nhb1$mean_SECS)
nhb1$z_EconOrient <- scale(nhb1$EconOrient)
nhb1$z_SocOrient <- scale(nhb1$SocOrient)
nhb1$z_PolOrient <- scale(nhb1$PolOrient)
nhb1$composite_political_orientation <- rowMeans(nhb1[, c("z_mean_SECS", "z_EconOrient", "z_SocOrient", "z_PolOrient")], na.rm = TRUE)
nhb1$composite_political_orientation_z <- scale(nhb1$composite_political_orientation)

# Compute standardized scores for mean intergroup bias in the combined dataset
nhb1$z_total_ingroup_minus_outgroup_points <- scale(nhb1$total_ingroup_minus_outgroup_points)
nhb1$z_ingroup_minus_outgroup_traits_positive <- scale(nhb1$ingroup_minus_outgroup_traits_positive)
nhb1$z_ingroup_minus_outgroup_identify <- scale(nhb1$ingroup_minus_outgroup_identify)
nhb1$mean_intergroup_bias <- rowMeans(nhb1[, c("z_total_ingroup_minus_outgroup_points", "z_ingroup_minus_outgroup_traits_positive", "z_ingroup_minus_outgroup_identify")], na.rm = TRUE)
nhb1$mean_intergroup_bias_z <- scale(nhb1$mean_intergroup_bias)
```

## Recode demographics

```{r}
nhb1$dem_Sex <- replace_values(nhb1$dem_Sex,
                               c("trans male", "male") ~ "male",
                               c("female", "trans female") ~ "female",
                               c("missing", "Prefer not to say", "non-binary") ~ NA)
                               
nhb1$dem_Education <- replace_values(nhb1$dem_Education,
                                     c("Less than High School", "High School / GED", "Some College") ~ "BE", # basic education
                                     c("4-year College Degree", "2-year College Degree") ~ "UG", # undergraduate
                                     c("Masters Degree", "Professional or Doctoral Degree (JD, MD, PhD)") ~ "PG", # postgraduate
                                     NA ~ NA)

nhb1$dem_Race_recoded <- replace_values(nhb1$dem_Race_recoded,
                                        c("Black", "Asian", "Non-White Hispanic", "Multiracial", "Native", "Pacific Islander") ~ "NW",
                                        "White" ~ "W",
                                        "Did not specify" ~ NA)

# Apply to NHB1a and NHB1b
nhb1a <- nhb1[nhb1$platform == "Prolific", ]
nhb1b <- nhb1[nhb1$platform == "MTurk", ]

```

## Association between bias and ideology

### Combined sample

```{r}
# Define model equation
exploratory_np1_formula <- mean_intergroup_bias_z ~ dem_Age + dem_Race_recoded + dem_Sex + dem_Education + composite_political_orientation_z

# Fit frequentist model
exploratory_np1_freqmodel <- lm(exploratory_np1_formula, nhb1)

# Fit Bayesian model
exploratory_np1_priors <- c(set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)", class = "b"))

exploratory_np1_bayesmodel <- brm(
  formula = exploratory_np1_formula, 
  data = nhb1, 
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = exploratory_np1_priors,
  sample_prior = "no",
  iter = 100000,
  chains = 4,
  seed = 987654,
  silent = TRUE,
  refresh = 0,
  warmup = 5000,
  file = "./model-fits/nhb1/exploratory6_bayesmodel_np1"
)

exploratory_np1_priordraws<- brms::brm(exploratory_np1_formula, 
                                     data = nhb1, 
                                     family = "gaussian",
                                     prior = exploratory_np1_priors,
                                     sample_prior = "only",
                                     seed = 987654,
                                     silent = TRUE,
                                     refresh = 0,
                                     iter = 100000,
                                     file = "./model-fits/nhb1/exploratory6_bayesmodel_np1_priordraws")
```

#### Model summaries

```{r}
summary(exploratory_np1_freqmodel)
summary(exploratory_np1_bayesmodel)
```

#### Hypothesis test

Frequentist testing quantities

```{r}
# Coefficient estimate
coef1_freq <- exploratory_np1_freqmodel$coefficients["composite_political_orientation_z"]

# Confidence interval
confint1_freq <- confint(exploratory_np1_freqmodel, "composite_political_orientation_z")
confint90_freq <- confint(exploratory_np1_freqmodel, "composite_political_orientation_z", level = 0.90)

# p-Value (computed manually as one-sided p-value)
df_confirm1 <- exploratory_np1_freqmodel$df.residual
t_confirm1 <- exploratory_np1_freqmodel$coefficients[["composite_political_orientation_z"]]/summary(exploratory_np1_freqmodel)$coefficients["composite_political_orientation_z","Std. Error"]
p_confirm1 <- 1-pt(t_confirm1, df_confirm1)

data.frame("beta_z" = round(coef1_freq, 2),
           "CI_lower_95" = round(confint1_freq[1], 2),
           "CI_upper_95" = round(confint1_freq[2], 2),
           "CI_lower_90" = round(confint90_freq[1], 2),
           "CI_upper_90" = round(confint90_freq[2], 2),
           "p value" = round(p_confirm1, 3))
```

Bayesian testing quantities

```{r}
# Coefficient estimate
coef1_bayes <- fixef(exploratory_np1_bayesmodel)["composite_political_orientation_z", "Estimate"]

# Credible interval
cred1_bayes <- fixef(exploratory_np1_bayesmodel)["composite_political_orientation_z", c("Q2.5", "Q97.5")]
cred90_bayes <- fixef(exploratory_np1_bayesmodel, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))["composite_political_orientation_z", c("Q5", "Q95")]

# Bayes factor
exploratory_np1_bf <- bayesfactor_parameters(exploratory_np1_bayesmodel,
                                           prior=exploratory_np1_priordraws, 
                                           direction = "right", 
                                           parameters = "composite_political_orientation_z")

# Posterior probability > .10
postdraws <- extract(exploratory_np1_bayesmodel$fit, pars = "b_composite_political_orientation_z")
postProb <- sum(postdraws[[1]] >= 0.10) / length(postdraws[[1]])

data.frame("beta_z" = round(coef1_bayes, 2),
           "CI_lower_95" = round(cred1_bayes[1], 2),
           "CI_upper_95" = round(cred1_bayes[2], 2),
           "CI_lower_90" = round(cred90_bayes[1], 2),
           "CI_upper_90" = round(cred90_bayes[2], 2),
           "BFplus0" = round(exp(exploratory_np1_bf$log_BF), 2),
           "PostProb" = round(postProb, 2))
```
